subject: Problem with serving .pdf files in Chrome

messages.author: 55cb20da3fe82e18
messages.subject: Problem with serving .pdf files in Chrome
parts:
So I added the following to my server.R:

addResourcePath('fileplots', '/home/haider/R/shinyapp/output')

and then try to browse to http://localhost:8100/fileplots/plot1.pdf 

which works fine in Firefox (on both Ubuntu/Windows). In Chrome (Version 22.0.1229.94) on both Windows/Ubuntu it doesn't return the file. The only thing I got to work on Chrome is serving .txt files

Any ideas why?

Thanks

-Haider

messages.author: f806781d102fe0ab
messages.subject: Re: Problem with serving .pdf files in Chrome
parts:
Ah, I think there is a hard coded list of content types in Shiny and I forgot PDF. I think perhaps Firefox is sniffing out the fact that it's a PDF even though the content type is wrong. I'll file a bug. Thanks!

I just checked in a fix. If you'd like to try it out without waiting for the next packaged release of Shiny, you can always install the latest dev version by using devtools:

library(devtools)
install_github('shiny', 'rstudio')
